Class ArchiveRoom

java.lang.Object
moldsim.model.ArchiveRoom
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ArchiveRoom extends Object implements Serializable
Represents an archive room composed of four walls and an environmental context.

This class stores the room configuration and provides access to each wall as well as shared environmental parameters used in the simulation.
